description: This file defines data classes and a parser object for handling 'TalkDirective' JSON configurations within an Android application. It parses directives from text input, extracting various configuration fields such as voice, model, speed, and other speech parameters.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: Data class representing various speech directive parameters, such as voice ID, model, speed, and other settings.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: Data class that holds the result of parsing a directive, including the directive object, remaining text, and unknown keys.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParser
classes.description: Singleton object providing a static parse() method to parse text into a TalkDirective object.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a string into a TalkDirectiveParseResult, extracting JSON directive and remaining text.
